name: humanizer-lint
taglineEn: Deterministic Multilingual AI Prose Humanizer, Anti-Cliché Style Linter & Sentence Rhythm Analyzer
taglineId: Linter Gaya Tulisan AI, Editor Prosa Natural & Penganalisis Ritme Kalimat Multi-Bahasa secara Deterministik
canonicalEn: A local, zero-dependency prose linter that flags stiff, AI-sounding writing (stock phrases, flat sentence rhythm, repeated wording) and tells you what to revise. A style checker, not an AI detector.
canonicalId: Linter prosa lokal tanpa dependency yang menandai tulisan kaku ala AI (frasa klise, ritme kalimat datar, kata berulang) dan menunjukkan bagian yang perlu direvisi. Pemeriksa gaya, bukan detektor AI.
